newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji plans secondary offering of 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji plans secondary offering of 3 mln shares.

text.p: Takefuji Corp said on Monday it will make a secondary offering of three million shares.
Two Tokyo-based companies which hold Takefuji shares will sell a total of three million shares, Takefuji said in a statement.
Of the three million shares, one million will be sold in Japan and the rest will be sold overseas, it said.
In the United States, the shares will be sold only to certain institutional investors, Takefuji said.
The number of shares to be sold through the secondary offering could be raised to 3.3 million shares, Takefuji said.
The offer price of the shares has not yet been decided but will be set sometime between March 13 and 18, Takefuji said.
Subscription dates will be decided on the same day the offer price is be set, it said.
